units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 9:5">Pes. IX, 5</cite> <he>מִקְּחוֹ מבעשור</he> it must be selected (designated) on the tenth day of the month (<cite ref="Exodus 12:3">Ex. XII, 3</cite>).

senses.gloss: (traditional pronunc.) מֶקַח buying, purchase, bargain. Ib. 112ᵇ אל תעמוד על המ׳ וכ׳ do not stand bargaining when you have no money.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 4:3">B. Mets. IV, 3</cite> <he>שתות למ׳</he> if the overcharge amounts to one sixth of the price paid.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 50a:1">Ib. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>תן לי מִקְחִי</he> give me back my goods.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 50b:9">Ib. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>ביטול מ׳</he> annulment of the bargain.

Ib. 51ᵃ לוקח מקחו בידו the purchaser has his purchase in his possession (and can show it to his friends to have it valued); a. v. fr.—אבן המ׳ auction-stone for slaves. Sifra B’har ch. VII, Par. 6 (Yalk. Lev. 667 הלקח), v. סִימְטָא I.—מ׳ וממכר, v. מִמְכָּר.
